'''Cruva Lenda''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]<ref name="TF" /> who lived during the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> and was employed by the [[organization]] of [[Nirama]],<ref name="TF" /> an [[Oblee]]<ref name="Recursion">{{LivingForce|Belted In: Recursion}}</ref> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] based in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="TF" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']] to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]. As ''Scourge'' is an adaptation of the events of ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', the latter must also be set in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Lenda and fellow Twi'lek [[Ranso Li]] journeyed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in order to acquire some fast, used [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] for Nirama's [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation. On arrival on the world, the pair attended a party that was held by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]] in [[Popara's penthouse]],<ref name="TF" /> to commemorate the recent rescue of Popara's [[Gender/Legends|son]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika]] by the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Eddey Be'ray]] and [[Reen Irana]].<ref name="Scourge" /> During Popara's party, Lenda conversed with some of the other guests about the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system's]] qualities as a tourist destination.<ref name="TF" />

Lenda was able to [[Language/Legends|speak]] [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], and [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]]. The Twi'lek wore high-quality [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and was equipped with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="TF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cruva Lenda appeared in ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', a [[2002]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[roleplaying game]] supplement written by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The book includes a seating plan for Popara's party, revealing that during the event, one of Nirama's Twi'lek [[Agent/Legends|agents]] sat a table with the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] representative [[Miltar Dolor]], the Hutt [[Lungru Nokko Vimmas|Lungru]] and the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Kir Sesad]], while the other Twi'lek sat with Mika and some [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|Bimms]]. However, the adventure does not stipulate which of the seating placements applied to Lenda and which one applied to Li.<ref name="TF" />
